themes.summary: Intel has undergone restructuring and layoffs in recent years, but there are concerns about the effectiveness and competence of its former management.

mentions.text:
At least Intel has been restructuring over the past few years. They’ve let go of quite a few people who needed to go.

But former Intel managers do seem pretty clueless. I can see it on my own team.
